'''Kro Lann''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who served in a captive [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] village on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac|skirmish]] there. He fought a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]], who had been sent by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to liberate the village, in the center of the village alongside [[Mord Jayran]].
